goal: Return the bottom 10 negative billed invoice amounts (invoice level) for year 2000, show the same invoices' billed amounts for 2001 for comparison, and then compare those invoices to their linked sales-order amounts
resolved_question: Find the bottom 10 billed invoice amounts (negative values) at the invoice level for calendar year 2000 (use billed invoice amounts from billing documents). For each of those invoices, return: invoice id, billed amount in 2000, billed amount for the same invoice for calendar year 2001 (if present), and the total amount(s) on the sales order(s) linked to that invoice (include sales order id(s) and sales-order line amounts or order total as available). Filter billed invoice amounts to negative values only. Order the list ascending by 2000 billed invoice amount and limit to 10 invoices.

goal: Compare purchasing costs by supplier for 2012 vs 2013, showing absolute and percent change
resolved_question: For each supplier, compute total purchasing cost for calendar year 2012 and calendar year 2013, then return supplier_id, supplier_name, cost_2012, cost_2013, absolute_change (cost_2013 - cost_2012), and percent_change (100*(cost_2013 - cost_2012)/NULLIF(cost_2012,0)). Group by supplier, order by absolute_change descending, limit 10. Use invoiced/posted purchase amounts (finance postings or supplier invoice lines linked to purchasing documents).

goal: Show top 20 warehouses by highest stock balances for 2022
resolved_question: Rank warehouses by total stock balance (quantity on hand) for calendar year 2022 and return the top 20 warehouses with their warehouse identifier, warehouse name (if available), total year-end or average 2022 stock balance (specify aggregation: sum of quantity on hand across all materials over 2022) and sort descending by that balance.

goal: Run the comparison of total billed sales in 2018 vs 2019 by currency with absolute and percent change
resolved_question: Compare total billed sales in calendar years 2018 and 2019, broken down by currency. For each currency show: total billed sales in 2018, total billed sales in 2019, absolute change (2019 - 2018), and percent change ((2019 - 2018) / 2018). Use billed invoices as the sales source.
